title: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, from personal assistants that take actions based on users’ long-term behavior histories to recommendation and advertising systems that predict what users will do. These applications demand the user dimension of LLM intelligence: the ability to infer a person’s preferences, intent, and likely future actions from weeks to years of user behavior data. Yet current models remain limited in this user dimension of intelligence: they are trained on static text or synthetic data, neither of which captures how user behavior evolves over time. Real-world user behavior data, by contrast, is already available at scale on content platforms and in personal-assistant agents. These records capture sequences of user actions, making the user’s actual behavior a natural supervisory signal with the potential to improve LLM intelligence. To this end, we propose user behavior as supervision, a paradigm in which the training signal for LLMs comes from the user’s real behavior in content platforms. We further introduce Vela, a framework that operationalizes this paradigm by converting real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories. From the anonymized behavior records of 100,000 users, Vela generates 100,000 tasks across 91 real-world task templates. Difficulty-based filtering and trajectory acceptance criteria jointly retain approximately 75,000 tasks with selected training trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these training trajectories improves performance over the base model by up to 11.5 points on user-related tasks and by an average of 4 points on general benchmarks. Scaling experiments further show that training on more user behavior data improves user-related performance. Reinforcement learning after fine-tuning outperforms reinforcement learning from the base model by up to 7.7 points on user-related tasks. These gains suggest that using real-world user behavior as supervision can improve not only user-centered capabilities but also the broader intelligence of LLMs.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In our graduate seminar on Personalized Language Models, today's lecture is on Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks L-L-M Intelligence. Work such as Collab L-L-M: From Passive Responders to Active Collaborators and From 1,000,000 Users to Every User: Scaling Up Personalized Preference for User-level Alignment reflects a growing interest in personalized systems. Vela, from the AllSpark Team, asks a broader question: can real user behavior train a general-purpose model, not merely customize its answers?
segments.zh: 在我们关于个性化语言模型的研究生讨论课上，今天的讲座主题是Vela：以用户行为作为监督信号，激发大语言模型的智能。像《Collab L-L-M：从被动响应者到主动协作者》以及《从100万用户到每一位用户：将个性化偏好扩展到用户级对齐》这样的工作，反映出人们对个性化系统的兴趣日益增长。来自AllSpark团队的Vela提出了一个更宏大的问题：真实用户行为能否训练出一个通用模型，而不仅仅是定制它的回答？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: I see your hand, Noah. Go ahead. The direction of this field matters because personalization depends on understanding an individual over time, not just matching a prompt to a general pattern. Vela shifts attention from user histories as information supplied at inference to user histories as sources of training supervision. That distinction could affect assistants and recommendation systems, but it also raises questions about evidence quality, privacy, and whether improvements transfer beyond personalization.
segments.zh: 我看到诺亚举手了，请讲。这个领域的方向很重要，因为个性化取决于能否长期理解一个人，而不只是把提示词匹配到某个通用模式上。Vela把注意力从“用户历史作为推理时提供的信息”转向了“用户历史作为训练监督的来源”。这一区别可能会影响助手和推荐系统，但也带来了关于证据质量、隐私，以及这些改进能否迁移到个性化之外的问题。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, does Vela train on what people did, rather than only what they said they prefer?
segments.zh: 教授您好，Vela 训练用的是人们实际做了什么，而不只是他们说自己偏好什么，对吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The authors define a user dimension of intelligence as inferring a particular person’s preferences, intent, and likely actions from their history. They use anonymized records from 100,000 users of a large social-media platform, spanning several weeks to years. Instead of asking a model to imitate generic descriptions of users, they turn sequences of actual views, searches, purchases, posts, follows, and dislikes into examples about specific histories.
segments.zh: 没错。作者把智能的一个用户维度定义为：从某个人的历史记录中推断出这个人的偏好、意图和可能的行为。他们使用了一个大型社交媒体平台上10万名用户的匿名记录，时间跨度从几周到几年不等。他们不是让模型去模仿对用户的泛泛描述，而是把真实的浏览、搜索、购买、发帖、关注和不喜欢等行为序列，转化成关于具体历史记录的样本。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: how do they keep future actions from leaking into the model’s context?
segments.zh: 问个快问题：他们怎么防止未来的行为泄露到模型的上下文里？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Each history segment contains roughly 72,000 to 120,000 tokens. The earlier portion, about two thirds, is visible to the model, while the remaining actions are held out as future behavior. Those later actions can then serve as targets for prediction. Vela builds 91 question templates in two broad families: predictive tasks about future behavior, and rubric tasks that ask for profiles, interests, writing style, or evidence-based explanations.
segments.zh: 每个历史片段大约包含72,000到120,000个token。前面约三分之二的部分对模型可见，剩下的动作则被留作未来行为。这些后续动作就可以作为预测目标。Vela构建了91个问题模板，分为两大类：关于未来行为的预测任务，以及要求生成用户画像、兴趣、写作风格或基于证据的解释的评分标准任务。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The predictive tasks include questions with candidate items and open-ended predictions. Objective selections can be compared with the held-out record; free-form predictions are evaluated through semantic matching. Rubric tasks use criteria such as factual support, coverage, and appropriate uncertainty, rather than requiring one exact wording. A useful analogy is an exam with both answer-key questions and short essays graded against a transparent rubric. The construction process produces 100,000 candidate tasks.
segments.zh: 预测任务包括带候选选项的问题和开放式预测。客观选择题可以和留出的记录做比对，自由形式的预测则通过语义匹配来评估。评分标准类任务采用事实支撑、覆盖面和恰当的不确定性等标准，而不是要求某个唯一正确的措辞。一个有用的类比是考试中既有标准答案题，也有按透明评分标准打分的简答题。整个构建过程产生了10万个候选任务。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How do they decide which examples are useful enough to train on?
segments.zh: 他们怎么判断哪些样本足够有用、可以用来训练呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: They first have a strong model generate four responses per task, then average the scores. Tasks scoring between 0.2 and 0.8 are retained, aiming for intermediate difficulty rather than examples that are trivial or nearly impossible. For each retained task, they generate candidate trajectories and accept the best one only if it beats the task’s average filtering score. This produces a curated set, not simply a dump of every interaction.
segments.zh: 他们先让一个强模型为每个任务生成四个回答，然后取平均分。得分在0.2到0.8之间的任务会被保留，目的是选取中等难度的任务，而不是那些太简单或几乎不可能完成的例子。对于每个保留下来的任务，他们会生成候选轨迹，只有当最佳轨迹超过了该任务的平均筛选分数时才会被采纳。这样得到的是一个经过筛选的数据集，而不是把所有交互简单堆在一起。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The main instruction corpus, Vela-Instruct, contains about 75,000 accepted examples; a smaller corpus, Vela-RFT, contains 9,375. The researchers fine-tune the same 35-billion-parameter base model on each. Evaluation then checks three things: held-out tasks from the same templates, four user-related benchmarks from different settings, and five general benchmarks. This design tests whether the method helps beyond the exact questions used to construct its training examples.
segments.zh: 主指令语料库Vela-Instruct包含约75,000条被接受的样本；一个较小的语料库Vela-RFT包含9,375条。研究者分别在同一个350亿参数的基座模型上进行微调。评估随后检查三件事：来自相同模板的留出任务、来自不同场景的四个用户相关基准，以及五个通用基准。这一设计检验了该方法能否在用于构建其训练样本的具体问题之外同样有效。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So does that training transfer, or does it only help on the Vela tasks?
segments.zh: 那这种训练到底能不能迁移，还是说只在Vela那类任务上管用？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The larger instruction-tuned model reaches 63.0 on VelaBench, up from 51.5 for the base model. It also gains an average of 6.2 points across four user-related out-of-distribution benchmarks, including 11.2 points on ad recommendation and 10.1 on profile summarization. Purchase-intent prediction changes very little. That uneven pattern matters: the approach helps several user-focused tasks, but it does not improve every capability equally.
segments.zh: 更大的指令微调模型在VelaBench上达到63.0，而基础模型只有51.5。它在四个与用户相关的分布外基准上平均提升6.2分，其中广告推荐提升11.2分，用户画像摘要提升10.1分。购买意图预测几乎没有变化。这种不均衡的模式很重要：该方法能帮助若干面向用户的任务，但并不是每一项能力都能同等提升。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: There is also transfer to general benchmarks: the average rises from 54.2 to 58.2, with notable gains in instruction following and long-context learning. More training data is associated with better scores: scaling Vela-Instruct from 4,700 to 75,000 examples lifts VelaBench from 59.2 to 63.0. Yet the smaller self-generated corpus has weaker results, and some individual scores decline. So the effect depends on the training recipe, not just the presence of behavior data.
segments.zh: 它也能迁移到通用基准上：平均分从54.2升到58.2，在指令遵循和长上下文学习上提升明显。训练数据越多，分数越高：把Vela-Instruct从4700个样本扩展到75000个，VelaBench就从59.2升到63.0。但较小的自生成语料效果更差，有些单项分数还会下降。所以效果取决于训练配方，而不只是有没有行为数据。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Could this be a better starting point for reinforcement learning, too?
segments.zh: 这是否也能作为强化学习更好的起点呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In the reported comparison, yes. Under the same reinforcement-learning setup, starting from the Vela checkpoint yields 66.2 on VelaBench, versus 58.5 from the base model, and 37.6 on profile summarization, versus 29.9. This suggests behavior-derived training can provide a useful initialization. Still, these are results under specific configurations; they do not prove that the advantage will hold for different platforms, populations, or deployment conditions.
segments.zh: 在报告中的对比里，答案是肯定的。在相同的强化学习设置下，从Vela检查点出发，在VelaBench上得到66.2分，而基础模型是58.5分；在用户画像摘要任务上是37.6分，而基础模型是29.9分。这表明，从行为数据中导出的训练可以提供一个有用的初始化。不过，这些都是在特定配置下的结果，并不能证明这一优势在不同平台、人群或部署条件下依然成立。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader connection is to personalization research, including user-level preference alignment and long-term interaction benchmarks. Vela adds a complementary idea: observed behavior can supervise model training directly, rather than appearing only as an embedding or context at inference. Its evidence is promising but bounded by one platform and by model-generated task composition and scoring. Anonymization removes direct identifiers, but responsible use would still require careful decisions about consent, retention, access, and sensitive inferences.
segments.zh: 更广泛的联系在于个性化研究，包括用户层面的偏好对齐和长期交互基准。Vela 补充了一个思路：观察到的行为可以直接监督模型训练，而不只是在推理时作为嵌入或上下文出现。它的证据很有前景，但受限于单一平台，以及由模型生成的任务构成和评分。匿名化去除了直接标识符，但负责任的使用仍然需要对同意、保留、访问和敏感推断做出审慎决策。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: For PhD researchers, the central takeaway is methodological: interaction histories can be transformed into diverse prediction and reasoning tasks, then tested for both task-specific gains and broader transfer. The results motivate more work on cross-platform replication, privacy-preserving data practices, and independent evaluation of rubric-based scores. Vela does not settle whether behavior-trained personalization is reliable or appropriate in every setting. It gives us a concrete framework for asking when real actions can teach models something that text alone may miss. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 对博士生研究者来说，核心启示在于方法论层面：交互历史可以被转化为多样化的预测和推理任务，然后分别检验任务特定收益和更广泛的迁移效果。这些结果推动了更多工作，包括跨平台复现、隐私保护的数据实践，以及对基于评分标准的分数进行独立评估。Vela并没有解决行为训练驱动的个性化是否在所有场景下都可靠或合适的问题。它提供的是一个具体框架，让我们去追问：真实行为何时能教给模型一些仅靠文本可能遗漏的东西。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
